title: Meeting Rosco

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Would you mind stepping to the left?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Would you mind stepping to the left?

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Well, would you like the reason I tell people or the real reason?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, would you like the reason I tell people or the real reason?

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Well I tell people it's because they're in my way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well I tell people it's because they're in my way.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: This mapping data.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This mapping data.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: This mapping data I'm collecting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This mapping data I'm collecting.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Oh I apologize. I always assume people know what I'm doing. This thing here is a Carto-Carry - little piece of Curzona kit that allows me to map the streets of the city.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh I apologize. I always assume people know what I'm doing. This thing here is a Carto-Carry - little piece of Curzona kit that allows me to map the streets of the city.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Well that's the million Lim question isn't it? Some say they are trying to build a comprehensive map to provide information for the citizens but I feel like something else is going on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well that's the million Lim question isn't it? Some say they are trying to build a comprehensive map to provide information for the citizens but I feel like something else is going on.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: I just know how these guys operate. The more data they can accrue, the more they can use it...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I just know how these guys operate. The more data they can accrue, the more they can use it...

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Think I have a choice sugar bean? No no no. I'm going to be here for a long time. Curzona got me by the boogaloos.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Think I have a choice sugar bean? No no no. I'm going to be here for a long time. Curzona got me by the boogaloos.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Owe a lot of money. More than a lot. More than just money. Ended up at Curzona factory, barely the shirt on my back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Owe a lot of money. More than a lot. More than just money. Ended up at Curzona factory, barely the shirt on my back.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: I'm doing this until I drop. Even if I could get to every street in a single lifetime .... This whole place looked completely different two map cycles ago.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm doing this until I drop. Even if I could get to every street in a single lifetime .... This whole place looked completely different two map cycles ago.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: One day you'll need to suckle from Curzona's teat. I can guarantee that. I'll be watching as you do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: One day you'll need to suckle from Curzona's teat. I can guarantee that. I'll be watching as you do.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Hey, it's not all bad. I get to walk a lot, see the sights. Some of my spine is still intact too which is nice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, it's not all bad. I get to walk a lot, see the sights. Some of my spine is still intact too which is nice.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Yes yes yes, of course. Look I'd better go map this street before it changes again, see you around.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes yes yes, of course. Look I'd better go map this street before it changes again, see you around.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: I have no control over what it's used for. Curzona having up-to-date information on people's whereabouts seems like a step too far.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have no control over what it's used for. Curzona having up-to-date information on people's whereabouts seems like a step too far.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Once they saw how tall I was they stuck a Carto-Carry on my back and sent me off. "Map the streets, easy work for someone like you." Well here I am, fifteen years later.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Once they saw how tall I was they stuck a Carto-Carry on my back and sent me off. "Map the streets, easy work for someone like you." Well here I am, fifteen years later.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you tell people?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you tell people?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The real reason please.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The real reason please.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The real reason?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The real reason?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Mapping data?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mapping data?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What for?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What for?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sure Curzona wouldn't have bad intentions.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sure Curzona wouldn't have bad intentions.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm sure Curzona wouldn't have bad intentions.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm sure Curzona wouldn't have bad intentions.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't trust Curzona either.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't trust Curzona either.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If you don't trust Curzona, why work for them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you don't trust Curzona, why work for them?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If you don't trust Curzona, why work for them?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If you don't trust Curzona, why work for them?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How so?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How so?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: When will you finish?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When will you finish?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess you should have stayed out of debt then.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess you should have stayed out of debt then.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I guess you should have stayed out of debt then.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I guess you should have stayed out of debt then.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sorry, that sounds awful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry, that sounds awful.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well thank you for the warning.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well thank you for the warning.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Well thank you for the warning.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Well thank you for the warning.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Curzona? They're up to no good, are they?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Curzona? They're up to no good, are they?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Curzona? They're up to no good, are they?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Curzona? They're up to no good, are they?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Then just stop working for them!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then just stop working for them!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Then just stop working for them!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Then just stop working for them!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is there no exit for you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is there no exit for you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Is there no exit for you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Is there no exit for you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Generational debt?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Generational debt?
